7:144.text: I have chosen you above men by My Messages, and by My speaking
. So hold that which I have given you and be of the grateful."

7:145.text: And We wrote for him on the Tablets the lesson to be drawn from all things and the explanation for all things
: Hold unto these with firmness, and enjoin your people to take the better therein. I shall show you the home of Al-Fâsiqûn

7:146.text: I shall turn away from My Ayât
those who behave arrogantly on the earth, without a right, and
if they see all the Ayât
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
, they will not believe in them. And if they see the way of righteousness
, they will not adopt it as the Way, but if they see the way of error
, they will adopt that way, that is because they have rejected Our Ayât
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)

7:147.text: (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
and the Meeting in the Hereafter
, vain are their deeds. Are they requited with anything except what they used to do?

7:148.text: made in his absence, out of their ornaments, the image of a calf
. Did they not see that it could neither speak to them nor guide them to the way? They took it

7:149.text: And when they regretted and saw that they had gone astray, they
said: "If our Lord have not mercy upon us and forgive us, we shall certainly be of the losers."
